Matt 9:6's *the Son of Adam hath power on earth to forgive sins* is the in-flesh exercise of the authority that 1 Enoch 48 names as eternally-pre-existent. The figure who has the Father's-forgiveness-prerogative in flesh is the figure 1 Enoch had named as pre-existent. Red Line #12 governs the named-title rendering (not kaph-comparative).

*And the shepherds (corrupt leaders) who had not fed the sheep were judged, and cast into the same fiery abyss with the beasts.* 1 Enoch 90:16 (within the Animal Apocalypse) names the shepherds-who-had-not-fed-the-sheep judgment explicitly — the false-shepherds of Yashar'el (Israel) cast into the fiery abyss for failing the flock. Matt 9:36's *sheep having no shepherd* multitudes is the same diagnostic operative at the King's arrival: the contemporary-Pharisaic-Sadducean-leadership is the same architecture 1 Enoch 90 names as appointed-for-judgment. The Yechezk'el-34 anchor (canon-tier, S110) and the 1 Enoch 90:16 apocalyptic-witness both name the shepherds-who-failed the flock.

*And a new house was built greater and loftier than the first, and the Lord of the sheep brought all the sheep into that new house.* 1 Enoch 90:17 names the restoration-architecture immediately after the shepherds-judgment — the Lord of the sheep builds a new house greater than the first and brings all the sheep into it. Matt 9:36's scattered-shepherdless multitudes are the sheep the Lord of the sheep is in the process of gathering into the new-house-substance Yahusha (Jesus) is inaugurating. The wisdom-stream had named the gather-into-the-new-house architecture; the King at Matt 9:36 sees the multitudes in the present-tense fulfillment.

*And I saw till all the beasts and the birds and the wild animals were gathered, and they all feared the Lord of the sheep, and they began to praise Him.* 1 Enoch 90:18 names the full-gathering-and-fear-of-the-Lord-of-the-sheep architecture — at the end of the restoration-arc, all the sheep are gathered into the new house and fear the Lord of the sheep. Matt 9:36's present-tense seeing of the scattered multitudes is the Shepherd's arrival at the moment the gathering 1 Enoch 90 had named begins to be enacted in flesh.

*And your spirits have been found worthy of the lot of the righteous, And your names are written in the books of life before the Most High.* 1 Enoch 103:3 names the wisdom-stream's direct architecture: the names of the righteous are written in the books of life before the Most High. The framework's Red Line #11 reading of the names-written-before-the-foundation-of-the-world / names-can-only-be-blotted-out (Exodus 32:33; Psalm 69:28; Revelation 3:5) — names are not added after the foundation; they are written before and can be blotted out for unfaithfulness — is anchored at this wisdom-stream witness. Matt 10:32's confession-credentialing walks the same architecture: the King confesses the lived-confessor before the Father because the confessor's name was already written; the verbal-confession-without-Torah-walking is the failure-to-bear-fruit that risks blotting-out.

*And their memorial shall be before the Most High, And their name shall not be blotted out.* 1 Enoch 103:8 names the inverse of the blotting-out architecture: the righteous-who-endure have their memorial preserved before the Most High; their name shall not be blotted out. The framework reads Matt 10:33's *whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven* against the same Red Line #11 architecture: the denial-under-pressure is the failure-to-endure that risks the blotting-out. The names of the lived-confessors are preserved (1 Enoch 103:8); the names of the deniers are subject to the Matthew 7:23 *depart from me, ye that work iniquity* dismissal-from-the-Father's-presence. The wisdom-stream had named the architecture; the King at Matt 10:32-33 names the operative-mechanism at the apostolic-mission level.

*And in those days the destitute shall go forth and carry off their children, And they shall abandon them, so that their children shall perish through them: Yea, they shall abandon their children.* 1 Enoch 99:5 names the wisdom-stream's apocalyptic-register naming of the day-of-destruction family-disintegration: parents abandoning children, children perishing through parents. Matt 10:35-36's *I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother* walks the same household-division-pattern at the kingdom-citizens-hearing-the-Shepherd-divides-the-household register. The wisdom-stream had named the disintegration-of-the-household as the day-of-destruction signature; the King names the kingdom-hearing-of-his-voice as producing the division-line that runs through the household.

*And in those days in one place the fathers together with their sons shall be smitten, And brothers one with another shall fall in death Till the streams flow with their blood.* 1 Enoch 100:1-2 names the wisdom-stream's apocalyptic-register naming of the family-betrayal-in-the-day-of-destruction architecture: fathers and sons smitten together, brothers falling on brothers. Matt 10:36's *a man's foes shall be they of his own household* (citing Micah 7:6) walks the same architecture. The framework reads the seed-war (Genesis 3:15) as operative at the household-level — the kingdom-citizens' hearing of the Shepherd's voice creates a division-line the family-relationship cannot insulate from. The wisdom-stream had named the diagnostic at the apocalyptic-register; the King names it at the commissioning-discourse register.

*And then shall all the righteous escape, and shall live until they beget thousands of children, And all the days of their youth and their old age Shall they complete in peace.* 1 Enoch 10:17-22 names the wisdom-stream's latter-day-restoration architecture explicitly: the righteous escape, beget thousands of children, complete their days in peace; the earth is tilled in righteousness, planted with trees and vines, cleansed from oppression and unrighteousness and sin; all the children of men become righteous and all nations offer adoration. Matt 11:5's Messianic-credential answer cites the same Tanakh-prophet-cluster (Isaiah 35, 29, 26, 61) that the wisdom-stream had been carrying at the Messianic-age-restoration register. The first-coming credentialing-signs are the inaugurated-foretaste of the full latter-day restoration the wisdom-stream had named.

*But to the righteous and holy He will grant peace, and He will protect the elect, and compassion shall be upon them; and they shall all belong to Elohim (God), and they shall be prospered, and they shall be blessed, and the light of Elohim (God) shall shine unto them.* 1 Enoch 5:7 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Messianic-age-blessing-architecture: peace to the righteous, protection of the elect, compassion, belonging-to-Elohim (God), prosperity, blessing, the light shining. Matt 11:5's Messianic-credential answer (*the blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, and the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them*) names the operative-fact of the Messianic-age-blessing now-operating in the King's-ministry. The wisdom-stream had named the architecture; the King at Matt 11:5 names the architecture-coming-to-pass.

*And the wisdom of Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and righteous; For he hath preserved the lot of the righteous, Because they have hated and despised this world of unrighteousness.* 1 Enoch 48:7 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the revelation-economy: the wisdom-of-Yahuah (God) reveals the Son-of-Adam to the holy-and-righteous — the body that has hated-and-despised-this-world-of-unrighteousness. The framework reads the verse against Matt 11:25's *thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes* — the revelation-economy at the King's prayer names the same architecture: revelation is to the un-credentialed-receptive (the babes, the holy-and-righteous-who-have-despised-this-world); concealment is from the system-credentialed (the wise-and-prudent, the world-of-unrighteousness). The Father's sovereign-revelation-choice aligns with the substance Red Line #11's seed-war-hearing-pattern names.

*And for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before Him, Before the creation of the world and for evermore.* 1 Enoch 48:6 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Son-chosen-and-hidden-before-the-creation-of-the-world architecture. The framework reads the verse as the wisdom-stream anchor of the Red Line #11 *names-written-before-the-foundation-of-the-world* architecture extended to the Son himself — the Son named before the creation, hidden before the Father, revealed-to-the-elect at the appointed-time. Matt 11:27's *no man knoweth the Son, but the Father* names the unique-mutual-knowledge between the chosen-and-hidden-Son and the Father — the relational-substance the wisdom-stream had named at the apocalyptic-register restated by the King at the kingdom-discourse register.

*And there I saw One who had a head of days, and His head was white like wool, and with Him was another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man, and his face was full of graciousness, like one of the holy angels.* 1 Enoch 46:1 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Father-Son architecture at the apocalyptic-register: the One-who-had-a-head-of-days (the Father) and the Son-of-Adam-whose-countenance-had-the-appearance-of-a-man-and-whose-face-was-full-of-graciousness (the Son). Matt 11:25-27's Father-Son revelation-economy prayer walks the same architecture at the kingdom-discourse register: the Father (*Lord of heaven and earth*) and the Son (*all things are delivered unto me of my Father; and no man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son*). The wisdom-stream had named the architecture; the King at Matt 11:25-27 names it operative in his own voice.

*This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, with whom dwelleth righteousness, and who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, because Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath chosen him.* 1 Enoch 46:3 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Son-of-Adam-revealing-the-hidden-treasures architecture: the Son-of-Adam reveals the hidden-treasures because Yahuah (God) has chosen him. Matt 11:27's *no man knoweth the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him* walks the same revelation-economy architecture explicitly. The framework reads 1 Enoch 46:3 as the wisdom-stream's named anchor of the *son of Adam* lineage-weight (Red Line #12) restored — the title-naming case where the kaph-comparative is NOT operative; the figure is named the Son of Adam outright. The Matt 11:27 *only the Son reveals the Father* and the 1 Enoch 46:3 *the Son-of-Adam revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden* name the same operative-fact: revelation-of-the-Father is mediated through the Son.

*Woe to you, sinners, who persecute the righteous; For you will be delivered up and persecuted because of injustice, And heavy will be its yoke upon you.* 1 Enoch 95:7 names the wisdom-stream's direct woe-against-the-persecutors-of-the-righteous architecture: the same architecture Matt 23 will name in extended form. The framework reads the verse against Matt 12:14: the Pharisaic-system's plot-to-destroy is the operative-action that brings the woe 1 Enoch 95 had named at the wisdom-stream register. The yoke-of-injustice will be heavy upon the persecutors; the kingdom-citizens carry the King's easy-yoke (Matt 11:30) by contrast. The wisdom-stream had named the architecture's eschatological-end-point; Matt 12:14 names the inaugural-step that triggers it.

*And the Lord of Spirits seated him on the throne of His glory, And the spirit of righteousness was poured out upon him, And the word of his mouth slays all the sinners, And all the unrighteous are destroyed from before his face.* 1 Enoch 62:2 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Elect-One enthroned with the spirit-of-righteousness poured out upon him and the word-of-his-mouth as the operative-instrument at the day-of-judgment. The framework reads the verse against Matt 12:18-21's servant-citation read in light of Matt 12:20c (*till he send forth judgment unto victory*): the present-age ministry stages the credentialing-in-mercy-substance; the eschatological-consummation lands the judgment-unto-victory at the second coming. The wisdom-stream knew the Elect-One's enthronement and the word-as-judgment-instrument; Matt 12:18-21 names the inaugural-credentialing in the meek-King-disposition that precedes the enthronement.

*For wisdom is poured out like water, And glory faileth not before him for evermore. For he is mighty in all the secrets of righteousness, And unrighteousness shall disappear as a shadow.* 1 Enoch 49:1 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the wisdom-poured-out-on-the-Elect-One architecture. Matt 12:18's *I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the goyim* (citing Isaiah 42:1) walks the same architecture at the gospel-restatement register: the Father's-Spirit-anointing of the Son the King walks publicly through the Galilean-ministry. The framework reads the verse-pair as one architecture across two registers: the wisdom-stream knew the Elect-One's wisdom-anointing-from-the-Father; Matt 12:18 names the operative-fact at the inaugurated-ministry.

*And in him dwells the spirit of wisdom, And the spirit which gives insight, And the spirit of understanding and of might, And the spirit of those who have fallen asleep in righteousness.* 1 Enoch 49:3 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the four-spirits-on-the-Elect-One architecture — the same four-spirits-cluster Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 11:2 names of the Branch-from-Yishai (Jesse): the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of Yahuah (the LORD). The framework reads 1 Enoch 49:3 as the wisdom-stream restatement of Isaiah 11:2 applied to the Elect-One — the same Spirit-anointing substance Matt 12:18 names in Yahusha (Jesus) at the immersion (Matt 3:16-17). The Tanakh anchor, the wisdom-stream anchor, and the gospel-fulfillment name one Spirit-anointing-architecture across three registers.

*From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy... until the day of the consummation, the great judgement* (1 Enoch 15:11). The library tells where the unclean spirits came from — the souls of the dead giants, the offspring of the Watchers. These are the very devils the Son binds and casts out.

*And again Yahuah (the Lord) said to Raphael: Bind Azazel hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness: and make an opening in the desert, which is in Dudael, and cast him therein. And place upon him rough and jagged rocks, and cover him with darkness, and let him abide there for ever.* 1 Enoch 10:4-5 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the binding-of-the-watchers-leader-Azazel architecture: bound-hand-and-foot, cast-into-the-darkness, sealed-with-rocks, covered-with-darkness for the appointed-time. The framework reads the verse against Matt 12:29's *how can one enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.* The King's exorcisms-and-spoiling are the inaugurated-form of the binding-architecture the wisdom-stream had named at the watcher-leader register; the full-binding-of-Satan at Revelation 20:1-3 lands the architecture at the millennial-consummation. The wisdom-stream knew the binding-and-darkness-and-appointed-time pattern; the King at Matt 12:29 walks the inaugurated-binding-and-spoiling.

The framework reads the verse against Matt 12:29's binding-the-strong-man: the wisdom-stream knew the chains-prepared and the abyss-of-condemnation as the eschatological-architecture awaiting Azazel and his hosts; the King at Matt 12:29 walks the inaugurated-action that culminates in the architecture the wisdom-stream had named.

The framework reads the verse against Matt 12:32: the deliberate-attribution of the Ruach's-work to demonic-agency is the witnessing-and-rejecting-the-sentence pattern the wisdom-stream had named — the disposition hardened against correction with no repentance remaining. The Pharisaic-attribution Yahusha (Jesus) is responding to IS the diagnostic-instance of the architecture 1 Enoch 65:11 had named at its terminus.

The framework reads the verse against Matt 12:40's sign-of-Yonah three-days-and-three-nights-in-the-heart-of-the-earth: the wisdom-stream knew the earth-and-Sheol-giving-back-the-dead architecture; the King at Matt 12:40 names the inaugurated-form of the architecture in his own future-resurrection that the Yonah-typology pre-announces. *And the wisdom of the Lord of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and righteous; for he hath preserved the lot of the righteous, because they have hated and despised this world of unrighteousness, and have hated all its works and ways in the name of the Lord of Spirits: for in his name they are saved, and he is the avenger of their life.* 1 Enoch 48:7 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the wisdom-revealed-to-the-holy-and-righteous architecture: the Lord of Spirits reveals the Elect-One AND the wisdom-of-the-Lord-of-Spirits to those-who-hate-the-world-of-unrighteousness. The framework reads the verse against Matt 13:11's *because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.* The Greek *dedotai* (passive-perfect-tense, *it has been given*) names a giving-that-precedes-the-hearing; the wisdom-stream had named the architecture at the elect-receiving register. The disciples-hear because they have-been-given-to-hear; the multitudes-do-not-hear because they have-not-been-given. The giving precedes; the response reveals. Election-precedes-hearing per Red Line #11.

*And Uri'el said to me: "Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgment in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.* 1 Enoch 19:1 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the spirits-of-the-watchers leading-mankind-astray architecture. The wicked-one snatches the seed by leading-the-hearer-astray; the wisdom-stream had named the architecture; the King names the operative-form at the parable-of-the-sower register. The disposition-to-be-led-astray (the not-understanding of v.19) is what the wicked-one exploits.

The framework reads the verse as THE foundational-anchor for the tares-sown-by-the-enemy at Matt 13:25. The watchers' incursion produced the corrupted-line-of-the-giants and the spirits-of-the-giants that operate within-the-field-of-the-world as the seed-of-the-wicked-one. The King at Matt 13:25 names the operative-parable-form of the architecture the wisdom-stream had named at the chronological-source register: the enemy-sowing-tares-while-men-slept is the wisdom-stream's watchers-coming-while-men-slept-in-Yared (Jared)'s-days.
